metadata.title: NYC Metro ZIP Health Segments
metadata.note: PCA is fit only on health prevalence variables. Factor analysis with varimax rotation supplies the two interpretable map axes; demographic variables are used only after scoring to interpret the factors.

clusters.label: Young affluent core
clusters.description: Low chronic burden, high income and college share, and the youngest age profile.

clusters.label: Older chronic-care ZIPs
clusters.description: Older ZIPs with higher cholesterol, blood pressure, cancer, and lower binge drinking.

clusters.label: Middle health profile
clusters.description: The large center of the map: moderate health burden and middle-to-high socioeconomic indicators.

clusters.label: High-burden ZIPs
clusters.description: Higher deprivation, lower income and college share, and elevated smoking, obesity, sleep, tooth-loss, and asthma rates.
